TS0290001.message: Target '{target}' on '{connection}' will preserve '{field}' as '{preserved}', generate a new target identity and match updates and deletes by '{key}'.
TS0290001.solution: No additional transform is needed. Change source_id_field in the unwind settings to customize the preserved field name.

TS0290002.message: Target '{target}' on '{connection}' accepts the expanded key '{key}' without renaming the parent identity.
TS0290002.solution: The current field names are retained.

TS0290003.message: Target '{target}' on '{connection}' cannot safely preserve '{field}' as '{preserved}': {reason}.
TS0290003.solution: Resolve the field collision or target identity constraints before starting. Source values and existing business constraints are not overwritten.

TS0290004.message: {target} on {connection} is empty, so the full load starts from nothing.
TS0290004.solution: Start with the selected configuration; whether to proceed is determined by the report behavior.

TS0290005.message: {target} on {connection} already holds {holding}; this pipeline is set to clear it before a new full load (on_full_load: clear).
TS0290005.solution: Confirm that clearing the target before starting is intended.

TS0290006.message: {target} on {connection} already holds {holding}. This start runs a new full load without clearing it, so rows whose source rows were deleted will stay.
TS0290006.solution: Answer the offered question explicitly; the existing configuration is not changed automatically.

TS0290007.message: {target} on {connection} already holds {holding}. This start runs a new full load without clearing it, so rows whose source rows were deleted will stay. Its write settings come from the shared definition {definition}, so clearing first is set there, not here.
TS0290007.solution: Change the shared definition if the clearing policy needs to change, then check again.

TS0290008.message: {target} on {connection} already holds {holding}, and on_full_load is fail, so this start's new full load is refused.
TS0290008.solution: Empty {target}, or set on_full_load to clear or append, then start again.

TS0290009.message: Could not tell whether {target} on {connection} holds rows: {reason}. The start goes ahead without asking.
TS0290009.solution: Check target access and metadata permissions; an unknown row count does not mean an empty target.

TS0290010.message: The {check} start check could not be evaluated: {reason}.
TS0290010.solution: Inspect the cause and the report behavior; an unavailable check is not a passed check.

TS0290011.message: Clear {target} before the full load, and set on_full_load: clear on {element}
TS0290011.solution: Confirm that this choice clears target rows and changes subsequent full loads.

TS0290012.message: Keep the rows already in {target} and start anyway
TS0290012.solution: Confirm the consequences of keeping existing rows before selecting this action.
